data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 780's gross claims outstanding at the start of the year (comparative column) was 507.0 (USD millions). Over the 2018 year the gross claims outstanding reduced (release) by approximately 46.6 (USD millions), driven primarily by favourable development on older years and reinsurance recoveries, resulting in a lower closing gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2018. The movement appears to be a portfolio-wide favourable run-off rather than a single large adverse development.
